rows.whatTheReadActuallyFound: VF01 reported the twenty checkboxes as carrying NO field-map row. Measured first-hand in this lane against the three pinned binaries with pdf-lib, that is not where the defect was: the map already carried all 165 official widgets, the twenty among them, in maps[].selectionControls -- 52/52, 33/33 and 80/80. What the rows said was the defect, and it was worse than a bookkeeping gap because the map asserted things about the page that were false.
defectsFoundAndFixed: Six rows on 200-00130 (10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17) carried the literal string "undefined" where their route reason belongs -- reason: "undefined; this branch of the form is never populated with participant data on this route" -- and carried no why at all. censusOf never copied routeReason off the policy entry, so every OFFROUTE and SELECT reason was dropped between the policy table and the map.

Field 18, the box the packet's own route mark lands on, was declared selected_by_route with its reason and why both undefined, so the one mark the packet draws was declared without the reason for drawing it.

production-field-map.json declared routeSelectionsMade as the literal empty array, hardcoded, while the build struck two diagonals through question 2 in both fixtures. The map denied making the only selection the packet makes.

Every checkbox printedLabel carried the form's own Wingdings box glyphs as control characters (U+0007 U+0006 on the petition forms, U+0005 U+007F on one fee-waiver line), so what the map declared as the printed caption was not the printed caption.

Ten of the twenty share a printed line with their opposite (YES/NO on both consent questions, Yes/No on the fee-waiver's employment, benefits and additional-assets questions). Nearest-printed-line gave both members the same caption, so the map could not tell YES from NO. Two more (200-00130 fields 12 and 14) carried the question as their caption and not the box's own word.

No checkbox carried an instruction, and participant-instructions.md disposed of all twenty in one sentence -- "Every checkbox. Read them and tick the ones that are true for you" -- naming none of them and not saying which the route had already answered.

600-00228 was generated and prefilled with the participant's name, address, city/state/zip, telephone, email, docket number and printed name, on a component whose manifest condition is unmet, whose filing disposition is do_not_file and whose page 2 is a financial declaration made under oath, while the instructions told the participant twice not to complete or file it.

The instructions' component table named `filing_and_expectation_instructions`, which is the sibling vt_exp_decriminalized-set's fourth component and is not in this packet; this family's fourth component is `process_guidance`.

scriptsBuildCensusV1VtSealNonconvictionS: censusOf now carries routeReason and the participant instruction from the policy entry onto every census row, so no reason reaches the map as undefined; officialFieldMap asserts a route selection and an off-route box each carry a reason, and asserts every declared blank checkbox carries an instruction.
printedCaption() strips the forms' own checkbox glyphs (all C0 controls and U+007F) out of every caption, so printedLabel is the words the form prints.

optionWordBesideBox() proves, against the pinned binary, which word on a shared YES/NO line belongs to this box: it reads the characters of the widget's own printed line, finds every occurrence of every option word, takes the one nearest to the right of the widget's rect, and refuses the build if it is not the word the policy names. Ten boxes go through it and each records optionWordLocatedInTheBinary with the x of the box and the x of the word.

routeSelectionsMade is built from the marks the build actually draws, carrying the document, field, page, box, printed caption, mark geometry and the painted-stroke count read back from the output bytes; the build refuses if no mark was recorded.

POLICY_600_00228's eight WRITE entries became participant-supplied blanks, so the fee-waiver form is rendered with nothing on it; FEE_WAIVER_COMPONENT_REQUIREMENT records the manifest's conditional rule, that its condition is not met on this track, the do_not_file disposition, the delivered_unfilled treatment and why the blank form is still delivered.

participant-instructions.md gains a generated table of all twenty checkboxes -- form, page, the words printed beside the box, what to do -- built from the field map so the two cannot drift; the fee-waiver copy says the form is delivered blank and why; the component table names process_guidance.

feeWaiverTreatmentChosen.decidedBy: data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json -> packetSets[vt_seal_nonconviction-set]: the fee-waiver component is `conditional` with conditionDescription "Only where a filing fee is charged; on this track none is.", and the apply_fee_waiver participant action is conditional on "Applies only when the participant cannot pay the filing fee" and says in the participant's own words "Use it only if you are asking the court to waive the filing fee; if you are paying the fee, you do not need it."
feeWaiverTreatmentChosen.whatThatMeansOnThePage: 600-00228 is delivered exactly as the Vermont Judiciary publishes it, with nothing written on it -- no name, no address, no docket number, and none of the income, expense or asset figures on the sworn declaration. Read back from the flattened appearances of both fixtures, pages 5 and 6 carry zero inked appearances; a local raster of canonical page 5 shows every line and every box empty.
feeWaiverTreatmentChosen.whyNotDroppedFromThePacket: The manifest carries it as a component of this packet set and it is the Judiciary's single statewide fee-waiver form. Delivering it blank keeps the component the manifest lists while removing the thing that was dishonest -- a prefilled sworn financial declaration on a form the participant is told not to file. The instructions and the process-guidance page name the form, say no fee is charged on this track under 32 V.S.A. Sec. 1431(e), and say the only circumstance in which it is used.
feeWaiverTreatmentChosen.noRuleInvented: The condition, its resolution against this track, the do_not_file disposition and the when-to-use wording are all read from the manifest and the field map's componentRequirements. This lane added no eligibility rule and changed no route.
